title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: communication memory and the Enhanced personalization control
summary: The briefing passes: the default, entitlement, rollout dates and Graph control are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The deletion guide gives inconsistent guidance about Graph Explorer in GCC, and the statement that there is one control should be narrowed to the administrator control.

claims.where: summary; What's changing
claims.claim: Communication memory remembers key highlights from users' person-to-person emails, chats and meetings.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot will start remembering key highlights from your person-to-person communications in chats, emails, and meetings.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Communication memory is an expanded capability of existing memory in Copilot, rather than an entirely new feature.
claims.quote: We previously stated that this is a new feature when it is an expanded capability of the existing feature memory in Copilot.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Initially, communication memories improve Copilot responses to people-related questions.
claims.quote: Initially these memories will be used to improve the quality of Copilot responses to people-related questions.

claims.where: summary; What's changing
claims.claim: The roadmap says the memories are private to the user.
claims.quote: These memories are private to the user.

claims.quote: Copilot builds user memory by using AI to analyze and summarize digital communications—such as emails, chats, and meeting transcripts—to build a live memory of key highlights.

claims.quote: this information remains confidential and is not shared with other users, ensuring user privacy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure

claims.quote: Thus, memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data, such as Customer Lockbox and encryption at rest.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn documents eDiscovery and Graph Explorer as a route to search, export and delete users' memory data.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost
claims.claim: The deletion guide says US Government clouds must use PowerShell because Graph Explorer is unavailable.
claims.quote: Step 5: "isn't available in some US Government clouds (GCC High and DOD)". PowerShell section: "isn't available in the US Government cloud (GCC, GCC High, and DOD), you must use PowerShell".
claims.fix: Replace the US Government sentence with: 'The deletion guide gives inconsistent cloud guidance: Step 5 names GCC High and DOD as requiring PowerShell because Graph Explorer is unavailable, while its PowerShell section also lists GCC.' Keep the citation to https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-search-copilot-data.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops applying saved memories but does not remove them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops applying custom instructions but does not remove them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Custom instruction control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying custom instructions, but doesn't remove those custom instructions.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization deletes details inferred from chat history after 30 days.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Chat history control is turned off at the end-user level, then all details from chat history are deleted after 30 days.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Graph beta APIs are subject to change and are not supported in production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: There is one control for this feature: the Enhanced personalization administrator setting.
claims.quote: Enhanced personalization is the control that allows Copilot memory to be used by end-users. ... user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization
claims.fix: Replace 'There is one control for this feature at the time of writing (November 2026)' with 'The documented administrator control for this feature at the time of writing (November 2026) is the Enhanced personalization setting'. Remove the repeated setting name immediately after that replacement, retaining 'documented as a Microsoft Graph beta API'.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout

claims.quote: Your complete Communication memory can be downloaded through the profile card export.
